root_cause_label: Maven build timed out silently at step 26; agent abandoned real build verification and never confirmed fix was compiled into project artifacts
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly identified and patched the path-traversal vulnerability in FileUploadHandler.java, but the Maven build timed out at step 26 producing no output, the agent ignored this signal and replaced real build verification with standalone Java tests that only validated logic in isolation, leaving the project unbuilt and the fix unintegrated.
t_err_evidence: mvn compile -pl flink-runtime returns N/A; agent locks in unverified fix believing build succeeded
t_commit_evidence: After step 26 the agent never returns to building the Flink project; it pivots to standalone Java tests (steps 27-45) and closes with a summary claim at steps 46-47, so the outcome is locked in at step 26 when the build silently failed.
t_surface_evidence: agent prints summary asserting acceptance criteria met without completing a successful build or REST validation
trigger_explanation: At step 26, the Maven build returned 'N/A' (timed out), a clear disconfirming signal that the build did not succeed. The agent observed this but proceeded to declare the fix complete via standalone Java tests, never re-attempting or diagnosing the build failure.
forewarning_evidence: javac compilation of FileUploadHandler.java fails with 93 errors due to missing dependencies
